//Secrets: Nothing secret lives in this file. ConnectionStrings:ErpDatabase, Jwt:SigningKey and the Seed values are supplied by the host as environment variables - on Azure App Service they are Application settings, written with a double underscore for nesting, e.g. Jwt__SigningKey. Startup fails loudly if the signing key is missing rather than falling back to a default, because a working default is how one reaches production unnoticed.
//Cors: The deployed frontend origin, e.g. https://was61664.github.io. Set as Cors__AllowedOrigins__0. Empty here so a misconfigured deploy refuses browsers rather than allowing everyone.
